title: Identify the top 5 football teams in the 2015/2016 season that lost the few
question: Identify the top 5 football teams in the 2015/2016 season that lost the fewest home matches and, among those, have a build-up play dribbling class of 'Normal'. For each team, return its long name and the average chance creation passing score across all its 2015 attribute records.

prediction.sql:
WITH home_losses AS (
    SELECT
        m.XCL_013 AS team_id,
        COUNT(*) AS home_loss_count
    FROM Match m
    WHERE m.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
      AND m.XCL_015 < m.XCL_016
    GROUP BY m.XCL_013
),
team_attrs AS (
    SELECT
        ta.XCL_177 AS team_id
    FROM Team_Attributes ta
    WHERE ta.XCL_182 = 'Normal'
      AND ta.XCL_178 LIKE '2015%'
    GROUP BY ta.XCL_177
),
team_passing AS (
    SELECT
        ta.XCL_177 AS team_id,
        AVG(ta.XCL_183) AS avg_chance_creation_passing
    FROM Team_Attributes ta
    WHERE ta.XCL_178 LIKE '2015%'
    GROUP BY ta.XCL_177
)
SELECT
    t.XCL_173 AS team_long_name,
    tp.avg_chance_creation_passing
FROM Team t
INNER JOIN home_losses hl ON t.XCL_171 = hl.team_id
INNER JOIN team_attrs ta ON t.XCL_171 = ta.team_id
INNER JOIN team_passing tp ON t.XCL_171 = tp.team_id
ORDER BY hl.home_loss_count ASC, tp.avg_chance_creation_passing DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH home_losses AS (
    SELECT
        m.XCL_013 AS team_id,
        COUNT(*) AS home_loss_count
    FROM Match m
    WHERE m.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
      AND m.XCL_015 < m.XCL_016
    GROUP BY m.XCL_013
),
team_attrs AS (
    SELECT
        ta.XCL_177 AS team_id
    FROM Team_Attributes ta
    WHERE ta.XCL_182 = 'Normal'
      AND ta.XCL_178 LIKE '2015%'
    GROUP BY ta.XCL_177
),
team_passing AS (
    SELECT
        ta.XCL_177 AS team_id,
        AVG(ta.XCL_183) AS avg_chance_creation_passing
    FROM Team_Attributes ta
    WHERE ta.XCL_178 LIKE '2015%'
    GROUP BY ta.XCL_177
)
SELECT
    t.XCL_173 AS team_long_name,
    tp.avg_chance_creation_passing
FROM Team t
INNER JOIN home_losses hl ON t.XCL_171 = hl.team_id
INNER JOIN team_attrs ta ON t.XCL_171 = ta.team_id
INNER JOIN team_passing tp ON t.XCL_171 = tp.team_id
ORDER BY hl.home_loss_count ASC, tp.avg_chance_creation_passing DESC
LIMIT 5

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH home_losses AS (
    SELECT
        m.XCL_013 AS team_id,
        COUNT(*) AS home_loss_count
    FROM Match m
    WHERE m.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
      AND m.XCL_083 = 'A'
    GROUP BY m.XCL_013
),
team_attrs AS (
    SELECT
        ta.XCL_177 AS team_id,
        AVG(ta.XCL_193) AS avg_chance_creation_passing
    FROM Team_Attributes ta
    WHERE ta.XCL_182 = 'Normal'
      AND ta.XCL_178 LIKE '2015%'
    GROUP BY ta.XCL_177
)
SELECT
    t.XCL_173 AS team_long_name,
    ta.avg_chance_creation_passing
FROM Team t
INNER JOIN home_losses hl ON t.XCL_171 = hl.team_id
INNER JOIN team_attrs ta ON t.XCL_171 = ta.team_id
ORDER BY hl.home_loss_count ASC, ta.avg_chance_creation_passing DESC
LIMIT 5

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT
    t.XCL_174 AS team_long_name,
    AVG(pa.XCL_155) AS avg_chance_creation_passing
FROM Team t
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.XCL_171 = ta.XCL_177
JOIN Match m ON t.XCL_171 = m.XCL_013
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.XCL_130 IN (
    SELECT p.XCL_122
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Match pm ON p.XCL_122 = pm.XCL_081
    WHERE pm.XCL_013 = t.XCL_171
)
WHERE ta.XCL_178 LIKE '2015%'
  AND ta.XCL_182 = 'Normal'
  AND m.XCL_009 LIKE '2015%'
GROUP BY t.XCL_171
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN m.XCL_014 > m.XCL_013 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = (
    SELECT MIN(home_losses)
    FROM (
        SELECT
            t2.XCL_171,
            SUM(CASE WHEN m2.XCL_014 > m2.XCL_013 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS home_losses
        FROM Team t2
        JOIN Team_Attributes ta2 ON t2.XCL_171 = ta2.XCL_177
        JOIN Match m2 ON t2.XCL_171 = m2.XCL_013
        WHERE ta2.XCL_178 LIKE '2015%'
          AND ta2.XCL_182 = 'Normal'
          AND m2.XCL_009 LIKE '2015%'
        GROUP BY t2.XCL_171
    )
)
ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN m.XCL_014 > m.XCL_013 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ASC
LIMIT 5
